audit.whatIsWrong: Lane-difficulty phrasing was generic; the stage sides did not match the prose that describes the lane.
audit.why: Heimerdinger's difficulty here is stage-shaped: he owns 2 through 5 with the nest, loses 6 and the item game.
audit.corrected: Stage whys rewritten to name the actual mechanism at each level, matching the packet chart and the content whys.

audit.why: spikes[0..3] already name Lvl 2-3 nest, Lvl 4-5 stun zone, Level 6 Fear Beyond Death, and 2+ item percent-HP scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page said Disdain (E) shields Urgot while he charges, so it eats the burst you throw at his commit.
audit.why: Riot's Disdain text: 'Urgot charges in a direction, shielding himself'. The shield absorbs the very burst players spend on his engage.
audit.corrected: Key Ability Interactions and the cooldown block now state the shield and Disdain's 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s cooldown as the fight window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere.
audit.why: Concrete numbers make the advice actionable — Disdain 14-16s, CH-3X 11s, UPGRADE!!! 100/85/70s.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries real numbers on both sides.

edits.before: One turret + AA wins level 1 against almost everyone. Identify how Urgot contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Neither punishes at Level 1: you have no CH-3X stun yet and Urgot is just as slow. Bank the turret and take safe last-hits.

edits.before: Three turrets make your half of lane a no-entry zone. Only take the trade when Urgot's Disdain is down.
edits.after: Your second H-28G plus slowing electron beams make him eat chip just to walk in and fire Purge at 490 range.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Urgot must walk into your range.
edits.after: Full kit online — CH-3X answers his Disdain flip, and Disdain is down 15s after it misses. Keep the wave in the beams.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Disdain's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your hardest zone: three turrets plus the center-stun make a Disdain flip-in suicidal. Bank the lead while it is down 14-16s.

edits.before: Upgraded E or W deletes his all-in — choose per fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Urgot's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Fear Beyond Death chains you, and the recast suppresses and drags you back through Purge. Never sit low in flip range at 6.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Disdain's cooldown.
edits.after: Liandry's and the UPGRADE!!! turret hold lane, but a tanky Urgot can eat beams to land his flip.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Urgot carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: His percent-max-HP leg-shotguns plus Death's Dance out-stat the turret economy. Close it before the slug-fest arrives.

edits.before: Track Urgot's Disdain (Flip): His engage. E-stun/dodge it. When it is down — E-stun + turret him.
edits.after: Disdain (E) shields him mid-charge and eats your burst — bait it, then stun and nest him in its 14s down.

edits.before: - Urgot Disdain: matchup-defining — His engage. E-stun/dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Urgot Disdain: matchup-defining — 14-16s down, and it shields him mid-charge. E-stun it. - Your CH-3X: 11s, spend it only on his flip, never on chip. - Your ultimate: 100/85/70s — kill windows only.

notes: Level chart was internally inconsistent: phases/win said Skill or Heimerdinger at 6 and 2+ items while the content whys, late text and packet chart all describe Urgot winning both. Fixed as one atomic group with matched full/content pairs. Spell-shield/QSS/tenacity eligibility for Fear Beyond Death's suppression is not in the kit text and was not asserted.
